# Visual Effx

> Auto window tinting shop in Idaho Falls, Idaho, owned by Joe Harding. Shop at 320 1st St, Idaho Falls, ID 83401. Phone (208) 569-3775. Email VisualEffx@yahoo.com. Open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, closed weekends. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews.

## Services
- Ceramic automotive window tint for cars, trucks, SUVs and equipment
- Clear bra and paint protection film (PPF), partial and full panels
- Vinyl wraps, racing stripes, graphics and chrome deletes
- Headlight restoration, usually done in one visit
- Running boards, LED and smoked tail lights, bed covers, leather interiors
- Residential and commercial window film: solar, privacy, decorative and security

## Areas served
Idaho Falls, Ammon, Iona, Ucon, Rigby, Shelley, Rexburg, Blackfoot

## Facts
- Window film blocks up to 99% of UV. Architectural film carries a manufacturer's limited lifetime warranty.
- Idaho law (Idaho Code 49-944): front side windows and rear window at least 35% light transmission, rear side windows at least 20%, 3% tolerance, windshield film only above the AS-1 line, reflectivity no more than 35%.
- Free quotes by phone or text at (208) 569-3775. Prices are given up front.
